metadata.title: Smart Developer Toolset | Sparky
metadata.description: Online tools for developers. JSON, Base64, URL, JWT, UUID and more — all in one place.

home.subheading: Secure, fast, and no installation required. All the tools you need, right in your browser.

tools.title: JSON Formatter
tools.description: Format complex JSON into a readable structure and catch syntax errors easily.

tools.title: Base64 Converter
tools.description: Encode text or data to Base64 or decode it back to its original format.

tools.title: URL Encoder/Decoder
tools.description: Safely encode or decode special characters and query strings in URLs.

tools.title: XML Formatter
tools.description: Format XML documents for readability and assist with compression or review.

tools.title: SQL Formatter
tools.description: Format complex SQL queries into a readable form for easier review.

tools.title: JWT Decoder
tools.description: Quickly inspect the header and payload of a JSON Web Token.

tools.description: Preview your Markdown input in real time.

tools.description: Convert special characters to HTML entities and back.

tools.description: Mutually convert between strings and hexadecimal representation.

tools.description: Switch between HEX, RGB, and HSL to inspect and pick colors.

tools.title: UUID Generator

tools.title: Unix Time Converter
tools.description: Convert between Unix timestamps and human-readable date/time.

tools.title: IP Address Lookup
tools.description: Check your external IP address and connection information.

tools.title: User-Agent Parser
tools.description: Extract OS, browser, and device information from a User-Agent string.

tools.title: Word Counter
tools.description: Count characters, words, lines, and bytes in real time.

tools.title: Case Converter
tools.description: Convert text to uppercase, lowercase, snake_case, camelCase, and more.

tools.title: Regex Tester
tools.description: Enter a regular expression and instantly see match results.

tools.title: Text Diff
tools.description: Compare two texts side-by-side and highlight the differences.

jsonFormatter.title: JSON Formatter
jsonFormatter.subtitle: Format, validate, and minify JSON data instantly.

base64.title: Base64 Converter
base64.subtitle: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 strings instantly with UTF-8 support.
base64.pastePlaceholder: Paste text or Base64 string here...

help.description1: Encode text into Base64 or decode Base64 strings immediately in your browser.
help.description2: Supports URL-safe Base64 and ignores whitespace when needed for robust decoding.
help.description3: All processing is done locally; no data is sent to external servers.

urlEncoder.title: URL Encoder / Decoder
urlEncoder.subtitle: Safely encode or decode special characters and query strings in URLs.
urlEncoder.pastePlaceholder: Paste a URL or text to encode/decode...
urlEncoder.outputEmpty: Encoded or decoded result appears here.

help.description1: Percent-encode text with encodeURIComponent or encode full URLs while preserving structure.
help.description2: Inspect protocol, host, path, and query parameters when a valid URL is detected.
help.description3: All processing runs locally in your browser; nothing is sent to external servers.

jwtDecoder.subtitle: Decode and inspect the Header, Payload, and Signature of any JSON Web Token instantly.

markdown.title: Markdown Preview
markdown.subtitle: Write Markdown and see the rendered result in real time with GitHub Flavored Markdown support.
markdown.previewEmpty: Preview appears here as you type.

help.description1: Live split-pane editing with instant HTML preview powered by GitHub Flavored Markdown.
help.description2: Supports tables, task lists, strikethrough, fenced code blocks, and auto-linked URLs.
help.description3: Your draft is saved locally in the browser; nothing is sent to external servers.

markdown.defaultContent:
## 🚀 Markdown Preview

A real-time previewer with **GitHub Flavored Markdown** support.

### Features

- Real-time conversion ⚡️
- Table support
- Auto-link generation

### Code example

```javascript
const greeting = "Hello, Sparky!";
console.log(greeting);
```

### Checklist

- [x] GFM enabled
- [ ] Syntax highlighting — coming soon
- [ ] Export feature
